unit_warning: vCPU and GPU units are comparison placeholders, not proven provider/hardware performance equivalence. GPU unit means one 80-GiB planning-class accelerator; actual throughput must be benchmarked.

workloads.name: Primary production
workloads.service_hours: 24x7 service; business-hours engineering plus qualified on-call
workloads.notes: Prioritized customer transaction/workspace services, restore plus reconciliation; degraded features allowed only by product acceptance.

workloads.name: Restricted institutional / Alexandria
workloads.notes: Same classification/authority at recovery; no default frontier/public-cloud disclosure; retention and entitlement policy remain OPEN.

workloads.name: Development and evaluation
workloads.notes: Rebuild disposable runners from controlled code; source and signed release artifacts have stricter recovery overlays.

workloads.name: Industrial/site installations
workloads.service_hours: Site schedule and local operating authority
workloads.notes: Local qualified control and safe shutdown independent of WAN; 8h is business-compute restore, never a safety-system downtime allowance.

workloads.name: Corporate and teaching
workloads.notes: Provider availability/export constraints require verification; no replication of a vendor SaaS runtime is assumed.

workloads.name: Independent recovery
workloads.notes: Capacity is derived from protected services; do not independently add another full production footprint.

proposed_recovery_order: offline trust and protected recovery identities
dev rebuild and ordinary workplace restoration

service_overlays.meaning: No acknowledged key change may be lost; isolated recovery copies and a tested change protocol are required. This is not a claim that ordinary backups provide zero loss.
Source, release provenance and non-rebuildable artifacts; disposable runners remain 24/24.

failure_domain_tests: Independent geographic hazards, power and cooling
Carrier conduit, exchange and upstream dependencies
No sole dependence on primary IdP, DNS, KMS or artifact service for recovery
Immutable online storage AND separately offline copies are individually evidenced
Restoration uses authorized data and preserves client/institutional boundaries
retention_state: OPEN; technical sizing is not records disposition authority

required_evidence: Business impact and recovery priority approval
Dependency restoration and timed failover/failback test
